svg.title: Litex context and rule search compared with Lean proof elaboration
svg.desc: Detailed mechanism schematic for let a = 1 and a + 1 = 2. Well-definedness precedes truth search. The equality shape selects equality search; the addition invites a direct calculation that needs a numeric value. A matching stored equality a = 1 and substitution rule produce 1 + 1 = 2, closed by calculation. Additional candidates are unspecified schematic placeholders. Lean terms are captured from the matching accepted native Nat example.
svg.text: a still needs a numeric value
